method: Profile complete pair/fan-in/broadcast communication using per-SM arrival durations from separate instrumented original Softmax. Candidate placements move mailbox page and common flags base; all formal performance uses exact original kernel. Train and validation separate. No operator confirmation feedback selection.
fit: Maximum of first-half and second-half training medians of per-launch maximum per-SM local duration; select among frozen132 placement/pair candidates per scope.
controls: PAIR_ONLY fixes offset0/page17; PLACE_ONLY fixes identity pair; WRONG uses family selected at next candidate placement but deployed at joint placement; POOL averages all placements before choosing family, deployed at joint placement; SHADOW learns a full choice on another allocation; BLIND strongest fixed candidate from two development full-operator runs, frozen before confirmation; JOINT_AA exact same parameters.
net_accounting: All per-arm measured host outer run including two warmup graph replays, every graph parameter update, and preallocated output extraction. Add full measured target profiling/train/fit cost to JOINT; validation, shadow and research serialization reported separately. Both candidate and each control pay their measured updates and same warmup protocol; shadow and other controls get calibration for free for conservative comparison. Common graph build shared/excluded. JOINT_AA pays the same setup as JOINT so A/A does not manufacture a calibration penalty. PLACE_ONLY and PAIR_ONLY candidate views conservatively pay the full actually measured target calibration, not an unmeasured cheaper subset.
statistics: Exact empirical process bootstrap over all6^6 resamplings;95% and99.6875% Bonferroni16 primary intervals. Primary JOINT vs identity/blind/wrong/pool/shadow and PLACE_ONLY vs identity/blind/shadow, two scopes. PAIR_ONLY and decomposition contrasts exploratory; JOINT_AA is an identity control expected compatible with zero. No historical global multiplicity claim.
stopping: Fixed2development+6confirmation; no outcome-dependent rerun or mapping replacement; preserve all negative outcomes and repair logs.100W,82C guard.
